name: com.checktrueprice/trueprice
title: Trueprice
description: AI shopping agents find coupon codes, test each in a real cart, track prices at 145,000+ stores.

tools.name: lookup_price
tools.description: True price (the lowest price the product really sold at that we know of, from daily checks and archived snapshots: `true_price`), price history, deal score, checked promo code and product spec (description, tags, options, SKUs, weights, images) for a product page URL of a Shopify store Trueprice tracks (e.g. https://example.com/products/blue-mug). History (`points`) starts the day Trueprice first read the product; `archived` holds earlier prices from archived copies of the store's page (Wayback Machine, since 2025-01), labelled "archived snapshot": snapshots, not daily checks, and not used in the stats or deal score.

url.description: The product page URL; a ?variant=<id> in it returns that option's own history

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find products by title words across every store Trueprice tracks. Returns store domain and handle for product_history.

tools.name: find_products
tools.description: Filter every product Trueprice tracks across its Shopify stores, like the Product Finder at /product-finder (same filters, same results as GET /api/v1/finder). Drops are % below the product's highest in-stock price in the last 7 or 30 days (daily history starts 2026-11-13). new_days = listed by the store within N days (first seen after Trueprice's first read of that store). One currency at a time (default USD). Sorts: drop (dropped products first, biggest drop first), new (new listings first), price (lowest first), rating (best rated first), reviews (most reviewed first), rank (each product type's cheapest in-stock products first). Each row has rating + reviews from the store's review app and type_rank (#rank cheapest of `of` in-stock products of its product_type and currency). 20 results a page; each has a url to its Trueprice price-history page.

query.description: Words that must all be in the title

product_type.description: Shopify product type, exact, any case

new_days.description: Only products newly listed in the last N days

has_code.description: Only stores with a checked promo code

min_rating.description: Minimum star rating from the store's review app

tools.name: product_history
tools.description: True price (`true_price`: lowest price it really sold at, from daily checks and archived snapshots), Stats per 30/90/180/365-day and all-time window (`stats.windows`: low/high with dates, average, price at window start, out-of-stock %, drop count, is_lowest, last_price_change), star rating and review count with history (`rating`), reviews from the store's review app (`reviews`: rating, count, star histogram, 3 recent reviews, Q&A, what reviewers mention), category rank among same-type products across stores (`category_rank`: #cheapest of N in stock, 30-day drop rank), units in stock per option (`stock`: qty, null = not limited, with its change history; `variants[].stock`), live price, every recorded price change, archived snapshots from before tracking began (`archived`, labelled "archived snapshot", not used in stats or score), 30/90-day and all-time low/average/high, deal score, checked promo code and product spec (description, tags, options, SKUs, weights, images) for one product.

variant.description: Optional option (variant) id from `variants[].id`: that size/colour's own price history

tools.name: lookup_gtin
tools.description: Every tracked Shopify listing with this barcode (GTIN / UPC / EAN), across stores: domain, handle, title, price and stock of that option, and its Trueprice URL. Barcodes come from the stores' own product data; coverage grows as products are read.

tools.name: store_codes
tools.description: Promo codes for a store that Trueprice applied in a real cart and the store accepted.

tools.name: cheapest_path
tools.description: The cheapest way to buy a product Trueprice tracks (same as POST /api/v1/prices/optimize): the exact steps (sale, each code, shipping, tax, rewards) with each step's amount, source_id (the code's deals id or the product URL), confidence and checked_at, then checkout_total = items − eligible discounts + shipping + tax (tax only with user.taxRate), effective_cost after rewards (null without one), codes rejected and why (not stackable, minimum not met, new customers only, expired), assumptions, and snapshot_id: the purchase_paths row that reproduces every number. Maths is deterministic code, never a model; ranking never follows commission. Pass a product URL, or domain + handle, or your own offers/coupons/rewards. path is null when nothing is buyable.

url.description: Product page URL (a tracked Shopify store or any store page Trueprice tracks)

offers.description: Your own offers: {store, url, price, checked_at, compare_at?, currency?, shipping?, available?, kind?, ref?}

coupons.description: {code, store, kind: percent|fixed|ship_percent|ship_fixed, value, min_spend?, stackable?, new_customer_only?, expires_at?}

rewards.description: {source, kind: percent|fixed, value, checked_at, store?, cap?, min_spend?}

tools.name: find_store
tools.description: Store domains for a brand or site name (e.g. "Nike", "allbirds"): `with_codes` = domains with promo codes a real cart accepted (count in working_codes; read them with store_codes), `tracked_prices` = domains whose product prices Trueprice reads daily (product count). Empty lists mean Trueprice doesn't cover that brand yet.
